Hi Miguel — thanks for the note and for sending the draft. Short answer: yes, for an Ireland entity a completed and signed W-8BEN-E is normally sufficient for Redwood to classify the payee as a foreign entity and avoid issuing a US 1099, provided the form is complete and includes the foreign TIN (or explains the lack thereof) and any treaty claim is documented.

A few practical items so we can move the payment out of hold today: 
- Please return a signed W-8BEN-E (page with claimant signature).
- If you claim treaty benefits, include the article and rate being claimed and provide the Irish TIN.
- If Neptune has a GIIN for FATCA reporting and is a participating/exempt FFI, include it on the form.
- If you prefer wire, please confirm the exact payee name on the bank account (must match payee record) and the IBAN/SWIFT. Our bank ops team needs that to draft the wire.

I'm looping in Laura from RevOps for the payee setup and to confirm Redwood's AP next steps. Rachel, FYI for the account cadence.

Jordan Blake

Hi Miguel — Laura here from Revenue Ops. Thanks for sending the draft. A few notes from the payee setup side to avoid extra rounds: 

1) Mandatory fields we need on the signed W-8BEN-E: chapter 3/4 status box checked appropriately, name of organization, country of incorporation (Ireland), foreign TIN (Ireland), signature, and date. If you do not have a foreign TIN, please include the reason in Part XX.
2) If claiming treaty benefits, enter the treaty article and the rate you claim; we will keep that on file.
3) If Neptune is an FFI with a GIIN and is claiming Chapter 4 status, put the GIIN.
4) Upload: please return the signed PDF via our secure upload link (DocuSign/PowerForm preferred) — we included a PowerForm link below for secure receipt.
4) Payment timing: once the complete signed form and the invoice are in our system we can process for payment in the next run. Our standard is net-30 from receipt of completed paperwork; given this is a hold due to documentation, we will prioritize this batch and target release by EOD Aug 5, 2026 if we receive the signed form today.

Banking: we do not need additional entity certificates unless the payee name on the wire differs from the payee on the invoice. If that is the case, include a brief payee name confirmation letter.

DocuSign/Upload: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789

Regards,
